summary: Eleven NBA Cup group games were played on Friday, and three teams came back from 17 or more points down: Dallas from 21 at Phoenix, San Antonio from 20 against the Lakers and Atlanta from 17 at Boston. Cooper Flagg had 34 points, five steals and four blocks for the Mavericks, and Jamal Murray scored a night-high 36 in Denver's win at Utah. Atlanta's 87-86 win at Boston and New Orleans' 105-104 win over the Clippers were the night's closest games.

games.headline: Hawks erase 17-point deficit, edge Celtics 87-86
games.story: Boston led 37-20 in the second quarter, but Atlanta outscored the Celtics 31-18 in the third with a 10-0 run and took a 70-69 lead before the period ended. Atlanta went ahead for good at 85-83 with 54 seconds left, and Boston's 3-pointer at the buzzer only cut the final margin to one. Jalen Johnson had 24 points and 12 rebounds, and Alexander-Walker scored 20. Jayson Tatum had 20 points and nine rebounds for Boston, Neemias Queta grabbed 22 rebounds, and the Celtics committed 23 turnovers.

games.headline: Quickley triple-double, Barnes 34 carry Raptors past Nets
games.story: Toronto went ahead for good at 22-21 late in the first quarter and scored 39 points in the third to pull away. The Raptors led by as many as 26 early in the fourth. Scottie Barnes scored 34 points and made all 10 of his free throws, and Immanuel Quickley had 24 points, 10 rebounds and 14 assists. Mikel Brown Jr. and Julius Randle each scored 21 for Brooklyn, and Toronto was without Kawhi Leonard and RJ Barrett.

games.headline: Cooper Flagg leads Mavericks back from 21 down at Phoenix
games.story: Phoenix led 92-71 late in the third quarter, but Dallas outscored the Suns 35-14 in the fourth. The Mavericks went ahead for good at 107-106 with 56 seconds left. Cooper Flagg had 34 points, eight assists, seven rebounds, five steals and four blocks, and Max Christie added 16. Devin Booker scored 31 for Phoenix, and Dallas was without Kyrie Irving and Dereck Lively II.

games.headline: Jamal Murray scores 36 as Nuggets pull away from Jazz
games.story: The game was tied 15 times and the lead changed hands 20 times before Denver went ahead for good at 105-104 with 3:51 left. The Nuggets closed the game with 12 straight points. Jamal Murray had 36 points, Nikola Jokić added 17 points, nine rebounds and 15 assists, and Christian Braun scored 20. Keyonte George scored 25 for Utah, which was without Lauri Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr.

games.headline: Trail Blazers lead wire to wire in rout of Warriors
games.story: Portland scored the first seven points, led 37-11 after the first quarter and stretched the lead to 36 early in the second. Golden State never led or tied the game. Deni Avdija scored 26, Toumani Camara had 20 points and eight rebounds, and Scoot Henderson added 18 points and seven assists. Yaxel Lendeborg led the Warriors with 18 points, and Golden State was without Stephen Curry, Jimmy Butler III and Kristaps Porzingis.

games.headline: Spurs rally from 20 down to beat Lakers 99-96
games.story: The Lakers led 43-23 in the second quarter and 68-59 late in the third. San Antonio then scored 13 straight points across the third and fourth quarters and went ahead for good at 70-68 early in the fourth. Stephon Castle had 26 points and nine assists, and Victor Wembanyama had 25 points, 16 rebounds and four steals. Luka Dončić scored 31 for Los Angeles but made 1 of 13 three-point attempts, and Austin Reaves had 21 points with seven turnovers.

games.headline: Grizzlies hold off late Timberwolves push to win 114-109
games.story: Memphis led by 14 in the second quarter, and Minnesota went in front 76-72 in the third before the Grizzlies went ahead for good at 82-81 near the end of the period. Memphis led 109-95 with 2:56 left, but the Timberwolves scored the next 10 points before the Grizzlies closed it out. Cedric Coward scored 22, Javon Small had 19 on 7-of-10 shooting, and Cam Spencer added 16. Ayo Dosunmu scored 27 for Minnesota, which was without Anthony Edwards, LaMelo Ball and Donte DiVincenzo.

games.headline: Heat hold off Knicks rally as Giannis grabs 23 rebounds
games.story: Miami used a 15-0 run in the second quarter and led 54-31 before the half. New York came all the way back and took a 92-91 lead midway through the fourth, but the Heat went ahead for good at 97-95 with 4:02 left. Bam Adebayo scored 25, and Giannis Antetokounmpo had 22 points and 23 rebounds. Jalen Brunson scored 27 and Karl-Anthony Towns had 19 points and 10 rebounds for New York, which was without OG Anunoby.

games.headline: Pistons score 42 in the third to beat Bucks
games.story: Milwaukee led 19-3 early, but Detroit answered with a 12-0 run spanning the first and second quarters and the lead changed hands 13 times. The Pistons went ahead for good at 53-52 early in the third and outscored the Bucks 42-26 in the period, later leading by 20. Isaiah Joe scored 22 with five 3-pointers, and Elijah Harkless had 14 points and eight assists. Brayden Burries scored 23 for Milwaukee, and Detroit was without Cade Cunningham and Jalen Duren.

games.headline: Pelicans edge Clippers 105-104 at Intuit Dome
games.story: The Clippers led by 12 in the first quarter, and New Orleans took the lead with a 14-0 run that bridged halftime. The Pelicans went ahead for good at 78-77 late in the third quarter. Zion Williamson scored 25 on 11-of-15 shooting, and Trey Murphy III had 25 points and six steals. Brook Lopez led the Clippers with 17 points, and Los Angeles was without Bradley Beal.

games.headline: 76ers lead wire to wire in 111-87 win at Indiana
games.story: Philadelphia scored the first eight points, never trailed and led by 32 midway through the fourth quarter. The Pacers made 5 of 37 three-point attempts. LeBron James had 21 points, seven rebounds and six assists, Anfernee Simons scored 19 with five 3-pointers, and Joel Embiid had 14 points and 11 rebounds. Jay Huff scored 18 for Indiana, which was without Tyrese Haliburton.
